impact: Higher yields and a likely December hike hit long-duration growth holdings (NBIS, PLTR, BE, HOOD) and the memory rebound in MU and DRAM; banks like C are more insulated.
summary: US CPI rose 0.4% in October vs 0.3% expected and core rose 0.3% vs 0.2%, a third straight 0.3% core print. December hike odds rose to about 90% for 25bp with about 10% for 50bp after Governor Waller said a half-point move should be considered at that core pace. The 2-year yield jumped about 12bp to 4.68%, the 10-year about 7bp to 4.93%, and Nasdaq-100 futures fell 1.2%.
title: October CPI runs hot: 0.4% headline, 0.3% core; Nasdaq futures sink
